content.comment_body: I have another question and hope someone can help. I have 4 [product_name] modules with [article_no] in the same network, all set as master. I realize that 3 out of 4 should be configured as clients, and one as a server. Is it possible to transfer data from one client to another? The manual only describes communication from server to client, not client to client, with examples limited to two devices. Could someone clarify how to set this up?

Hello [user_name], One [product_name] device can function as both a client and a server. For each link between two [product_name]s (with [article_no]), create two connections. Navigate via Tools > Ethernet Connections, right-click on Ethernet Connections, and add a new connection. Set up: - one connection as master - one connection as slave Repeat this setup for the counterpart device as well. For more information, refer to the Residential Home Application with Weather Station example under Application examples for [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to set up peer-to-peer communication between several [product_name] modules on a shared network. Documentation mainly covers two-device scenarios, causing difficulty and confusion when configuring bidirectional communication in larger systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear, step-by-step instructions on configuring multiple [product_name] modules for peer-to-peer communication, with practical examples covering setups involving more than two devices.
